row.notes: Lazily creates the global default object at 0x146ca59a0 (0x128 bytes, ctor 0x1442b3460, built from g_Vm_Registry+8) and returns without change when obj is that default. Otherwise scans the 16-byte entries in obj+0x108..+0x110 and returns if both qwords equal pair[0], pair[1]; if not found it records an error-trace entry (code 2) and inserts the pair at the front through 0x144391430(obj+0x100, ..., obj+0x108, pair). Context from caller: the pair is always {callback function, owner pointer} (Game_TileList_ApplyBoundSelection or 0x1442b31e0 with the binding object), so this registers a change listener on a data-context object; 0x14420ae60 is the matching remove.
